name: Rank, pause, resume and stop commands applied on the next pass
steps: Admit two goals that each have a ready step while the host reports no free slot
Move the first goal down and read the swapped order on the progress topic
Free one slot and observe the higher-ranked goal's step start
Pause the waiting goal, free a second slot and observe no new step
Resume the goal and observe its step start
Stop the other goal with confirmation and observe it leave the progress topic
